annotations.text:
Source Sans 3 + Source Code Pro, and the new mark in the header — small, as asked, with the Trade.LINK wordmark beside it.

The logo is redrawn as vector geometry traced from your artwork: ring centres, hole diameters, node sizes and stroke width all match the original to the pixel, so it stays sharp at any size instead of being an upscaled bitmap.
States. The status light survives only where it reports a real condition — the MT5 connection. "Prompt copied" is an event, so it gets a check mark and no lamp.
The app as it stands today, drawn from the real source values — kept for comparison.
